The before tax and after tax amounts of other comprehensive income for the years ended December 31,
2013, 2012 and 2011 are summarized below:

VRSK_2013_p111__paragraph_0.ocr:
(1)
This accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) component, before tax, is included under “Realized
(loss) gain on available-for-sale securities, net” in the accompanying consolidated statements of operations.

VRSK_2013_p111__paragraph_1.ocr:
(2)
These accumulated other comprehensive loss components, before tax, are included under “Cost of revenues”
and “Selling, general and administrative” in the accompanying consolidated statements of operations. These
components are also included in the computation of net periodic (benefit) cost (see Note 17. Pension and
Postretirement Benefits for additional details).
